item.description: Katherine Lee understands the power of harnessing new technologies to drive journalistic impact. item.title: Colorado Trust for Local News launches fleet of community-focused newsletters
item.description: The Colorado Trust for Local News has completed a strategic digital expansion that brings community journalism directly to the inboxes of readers across the Front Range.Over the first six weeks of 2026, the COTLN newsroom launched six newsletters that are custom-built for email. The goal is to provide readers with topic- and community-centric news in a convenient digital format.
